risk_if_not_implemented: Without Timely Maintenance, maintenance activities may introduce unauthorized changes, expose systems to untrusted personnel or tools, or leave systems in an unsafe state. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Loss, Theft or Damage of Assets (R-AM-1), Recovery Failure / Unacceptable Recovery Delay (R-OR-1), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10), Manufacturing Capacity / Supply Disruption (MT-22), Supplier Financial Distress / Insolvency (MT-24), Transportation / Logistics Disruption (MT-26).

compensating_control_1.name: Software & Firmware Patching
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct software patching for all deployed Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), including firmware.
compensating_control_1.justification: Software & Firmware Patching (VPM-08) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Timely Maintenance (MNT-04) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Change Management Program
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the implementation of a change management program.
compensating_control_2.justification: Change Management Program (CHG-02) provides policy-level governance that compensates for the absence of Timely Maintenance (MNT-04) by establishing documented expectations, accountability structures, and organizational guardrails. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
